rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: BARsan
rows.Bloom: Cream, pink shading, apricot center. Mild to strong fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Compact. Large, semi-glossy, medium green, dense foliage.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Rose Barni says the blooms of this rose are creamy pink with shades of apricot at the center...

And from the Rose Barni web site:

Awarded at Monza 1995 Concour as the best italian rose and with the Silver Medal within Floribundas. Gold Medal at Baden Baden 1996 Concour. The color of the flowers is creamy pale pink, with apricot tonalities in the center. The flowers are big and double, in large clusters on a vigorous healthy plant. Nice scented. Height cm 70/90.
Internal breeder code: 3293. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli).
